I prefer w > x > y > z. Under the usual student-proposing deferred-acceptance (DA) mechanism, truthfully reporting my preferences is a dominant strategy, so I should submit my true ranking.

Because I already have highest priority at my most-preferred school w, there is no strategic advantage to misrepresenting preferences to chase a school that is more popular. Ranking any less-preferred school above a more-preferred one could only risk getting a worse match. Therefore I will submit my sincere ranking.
